review.notes: Triage review. (a) Full structural scan of all 1093 OCR lines: the single ``` fence pair (lines 868-879) is balanced and contains only the printed translation template; appendix letter headings, prompt-box banners and demo-box labels were compared against renders. (b) Full-document droppage scan: normalized 4-gram containment of every one of the 76 extracted PDF pages against the OCR markdown; all 33 low-containment pages were then inspected line-by-line and every miss resolved as figure-internal chart-axis/legend/bar-label text (pp.16-18, 40-41 judge-prompt template tables, 61 Table 7, 63-64 figures, 66-76 Appendix K tables), so no dropped prose, footnote bodies, prompt-box chunks or reference entries were found; the References section and all table captions (Tables 8-22) are present. (c) Renders visually verified at 110-250 dpi: pp.56, 57, 66, 71, 72. 'Acedemic' (A.2) and 'Hyerparameters' (B) on physical p.39 are the print's own spellings (PDF text layer finds 'Acedemic'/'Hyerparameters', not 'Academic'/'Hyperparameters') and were kept. The xMMMU-table value 116.33 for Aya-Vision-32B (physical p.72) is printed by the PDF itself and kept. Markdown '\_' escapes render as literal underscores matching the print and were left unchanged.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.56 prints 'F  Filtering Template and Filtered Samples' as an appendix heading in the same large bold style as headings G-J and K (visually verified); OCR demoted it to a plain paragraph while all sibling appendix letters kept their '#'-prefixed headings.

Rendered physical p.57 (Appendix F, Sample 2, TallyQA 'How many people can you see?') prints the ground-truth caption '5.' as plain body text directly under the 'Caption (Ground Truth)' label, followed by the Recaption label; OCR promoted the one-character caption to a spurious '## 5.' heading. The demotion matches the sibling Sample 1, whose caption '4.' stays inline text.

Rendered physical p.66 prints 'K  Breakdown by Language' as an appendix heading in the same style as F-J (visually verified); OCR demoted it to a plain paragraph while all sibling appendix letters kept '#'-prefixed headings.

Rendered physical p.71 ends the Table 14 (MaxM) table with the Aya-Vision-32B row of plain numbers 55.64 60.61 66.43 71.54 57.75 43.07 61.73 59.54 followed by the caption 'Table 14: MaxM'; physical p.72 then starts a separate table whose header row is fra_Latn jpn_Jpan ind_Latn por_Latn hin_Deva arb_Arab eng_Latn avg (caption 'Table 15: xMMMU' beneath it, visually verified). OCR merged the two tables across the page break and glued the second table's header cells onto the Aya-Vision-32B values. The patch closes the MaxM table after its last row and restores the second table's header row; cell text is unchanged.

unresolved.evidence: Figures 18 (FinQA) and 19 (Multihiertt) show example benchmark images; OCR additionally transcribed the table content visible inside those example images (French financial table, English/Chinese contractual-obligations tables) as HTML body tables next to the '(a) eng_Latn'/'(b) fra_Latn'/'(b) zho_Hans' sub-captions. The content exists only inside the figure images; removing the duplicated HTML tables needs a decision on the reader's figure-example presentation, so they were left unchanged.

Appendix F 'Filtering Template'/'Sample 1' and Appendix J 'VLM-as-a-Judge Prompt' printed boxes are flattened into single-cell HTML tables with concatenated line breaks (e.g. 'Question:{question}Ground Truth Answer:{answer}...'). Cell-boundary reconstruction is unambiguous in structure but wordy to patch; content matches the render.

Appendix K tables merge Table 8/9/10 and 11/12/13 bodies into single HTML tables under multiple caption lines, and the printed caption 'Table 16: MTVQA' sits beneath a table whose column set (arb_Arab...tha_Thai) differs from the MTVQA-like table that follows; the caption-to-table pairing follows the PDF's below-table caption order but the section's table boundaries remain flattened.
